method.processes: fresh per invocation, one untimed check per endpoint; filesystem cache warm
method.backend: target GCC compile/link and runtime are outside timed samples
method.stage_preparation: installed native stage binary; its construction cost is not in these samples
method.check: existing C-stage parsing and ordinary semantic checks
method.prepare: existing C-stage checks plus complete C text and symbol-rename construction in memory
method.stage_check: RMD reader, overload selection and mangling, then ordinary seed semantic checks
method.stage_prepare: stage_check plus complete C text and symbol-rename construction in memory
method.usage: wait4 process user/system CPU and peak RSS; wall time includes launch and completion
method.bootstrap: 10000 resamples of complete paired rounds; ratio-of-medians 95 percent interval
method.noise: one logical CPU pinned; shared caches, kernel activity, and machine-wide load remain uncontrolled
method.symbols: paired callee spellings have equal byte length; short and padded controls differ by four bytes per declaration/call

native_stage_preparation.scope: one construction of the native overload/reader/C stage from RMD source with an installed RMD C compiler; includes GCC optimization, object assembly, symbol renaming, and shared linking
native_stage_preparation.statistic: one observation per command; no confidence interval

conclusion: This is an explicit-name RMD baseline; no overload-stage cost or C-speed result is established unless its candidate is measured separately.
